title: Document Review Finding v1
description: A single finding from a document review pass (canopy plan-review, lamella-skills doc-review). Captures factual errors, missing content, or inconsistencies in documentation, specifications, or design documents.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Always '1.0' for this schema.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for this finding, assigned by the producer as a ULID. Enables correlation and tracking across document review cycles.

finding_type.description: Type of finding. 'error' = factually wrong or contradictory statement in the document; 'omission' = required content or specification is missing. Closed enum for exhaustive consumer branching.

severity.description: Severity level of this finding. Closed enum for exhaustive consumer matching. Matches threat-severity-v1 vocabulary.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the finding. Suitable for display in summaries or lists.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue: what is wrong or missing, why it matters, and what should be there instead. May contain markdown formatting.

section.description: Name or path of the document section where the finding applies. Examples: '## Architecture', 'Design Decisions / Section 3.2'. Null for document-level findings or when not applicable.

file_path.description: Path to the document file containing the finding, relative to repository root. Null for findings that span multiple documents or files.

line.description: Line number within the document where the finding applies. Null if not applicable or file_path is null.

suggested_resolution.description: If available, suggested text or content to add, remove, or modify to resolve the finding. May include prose guidance, example text, or references. Null if no suggestion is provided.

confidence.description: Confidence level that this finding is valid. 'confirmed' = verified or obvious; 'likely' = high probability; 'speculative' = hypothesis requiring human review.

deferred_questions.description: List of questions that must be answered before this finding can be fully resolved. Examples: 'What is the actual API signature?', 'Which version are we documenting?'. Empty array if none. Always an array, never null — consumers iterate safely.
